name: ANSI/IEEE Delta-star transformer form
summary: IEEE-library form of delta-star transformer: a delta-star transformer provides a delta-connected winding and a star-connected winding.
description: This reference locates delta-star transformer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. A delta-star transformer provides a delta-connected winding and a star-connected winding. Where the star point is brought out, its neutral and earthing arrangement are separate drawing requirements. The public library uses HXF1T14 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

Do not infer a grounded neutral merely from a star winding. A star winding can exist without an accessible or earthed neutral terminal. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
